Interop.lede: From national framework to live data exchange: one partner, the full stack.
Interop.stackNav: The three layers of the stack

approach.heading: Why full-stack.
approach.lead: Interoperability only works end to end.
approach.seams: Most programs buy policy, standards and technology separately, and the seams show.
approach.close: Arxia closes them: all three, delivered as one capability, from national strategy to live data exchange.

engage.heading: Across the lifecycle, or at any single layer.
engage.body: Arxia can run the whole programme end to end, or join for the one layer that needs depth. The path is the same either way.
engage.assessBody: Maturity audits and current-state diagnostics: what exists, what is missing, what comes first.
engage.designBody: Frameworks, data-sharing policy, semantic standards and technical architecture.
engage.buildBody: APIs, X-Road integration, registries and exchange platforms, in production.
engage.sustainBody: Governance, maintenance methodology and capacity transfer, so the nation owns it.

Eproc.lede: From procurement reform to a platform every officer trusts: one partner, the whole programme.
Eproc.body: Procurement digitalized from the first purchase request to the last payment, with every step traceable and auditable. We start with the rules and the people, then deploy ProcessPlayer, our own platform.
Eproc.proof: ProcessPlayer · {orgs}+ public organizations · in production since {year}
Eproc.programmeNav: The three tracks of the programme
Eproc.figCaption: Fig. 00 · An e-procurement programme · reform, people, platform

approach.heading: Why reform comes first.
approach.lead: A platform only digitalizes the process that already exists.
approach.problem: Most e-procurement programmes start by buying software. The law, the procedures and the people are left for later, so the system automates paper habits and officers work around it.
approach.answer: Arxia runs it the other way round: reform the rules and the process, prepare the people who will run it, then deploy the platform. One programme, so nothing falls between contracts.

inUse.heading: ProcessPlayer in use.
inUse.body: Built and proven in Romania, where city halls, universities, hospitals, airports and cultural institutions run their procurement on it. It can be set up in any country, configured to its procurement law and procedures.

umfst.quote: With ProcessPlayer, there has not been a single document, payment or payment order without its justification and supporting documents behind it.

sibiuAirport.quote: ProcessPlayer simplifies the procurement process and makes it fully traceable, from purchase requests to contracts. We warmly recommend it!

sibiuHospital.quote: All the information in one place: documents, procurement plan, orders, contracts. In short, maximum efficiency!

engage.heading: One programme, or a single track.
engage.body: Arxia can run the programme from diagnosis to handover, or join where depth is needed: a reform, a training programme or a platform rollout.
engage.assessBody: A diagnosis of the system as it stands: what the law allows, what the process does, what comes first.
engage.reformBody: Strategy, rules and redesigned processes, agreed before anything is configured.
engage.deployBody: Officers trained, suppliers on board and ProcessPlayer live, institution by institution.
engage.sustainBody: Local trainers, support and platform evolution, so the institution runs it.
engage.deliveryBody: Set up in any country and configured to its procurement law and procedures. SaaS or on-premise.
